name: Suntara Stones
summary: In Searing Gorge, Dorius Stonetender lies badly hurt and asks you to help him reach Ironforge.

sections.title: A Plea for Help
sections.body: Dorius Stonetender groans with pain. He feels light-headed as the world spins around him, and he is bleeding inside. He longs to return to Ironforge. So he asks you to help him make the journey.

sections.title: The Road to the Pass
sections.body: The road ends just short of Stonewrought Pass. There, Dorius is shot and dies. A letter he carried falls to the ground, singed.

faq.answer: Dorius Stonetender is badly injured in Searing Gorge and needs help reaching Ironforge.

faq.q: Where is Dorius trying to go?
faq.answer: Dorius is trying to return to Ironforge.
Dorius is badly injured, light-headed, and bleeding inside. The world spins around him.
